note: Design round 8, feature prci (Pull request and CI status), the option chosen: prci-compact. rows are copied from the design's prci.json, verbatim but for the sample names (SOURCES.json) (each row is the full HUD of base.cjs: hud4.js MIX.render on hud4-states.json normal with branch, add and del replaced, fable-off, colour style, left-aligned, with the 0.6.0 frame; line 4 gets the option's badge after the branch, the branch cut from the front with tailPath to the room left). The design knew no git state: its ⎇ is the engine's grey and its branch white. situations are the design's inputs (build.cjs SITS): pr.state open|draft|merged|closed, pr.ci running|passed|failed, pr.review approved|changes, pr.conflict a conflict with the base branch, pr.checks one letter per check (P passed, R running, F failed, Q queued; the compact option does not draw them).
name: Compact marks
optionNote: After the branch you see the PR number and one mark for CI: a gold ● while checks run, a green ✓ when they passed, a red × when one failed. A second mark tells the review or merge state: a second green ✓ means approved (two ticks = ready to merge), a yellow ± means changes were requested, a red ‼ means a conflict with the base branch, and a grey ◌ (with a grey number) means draft. A merged PR shows its number and the word 'merged' in enchanted purple, a closed one 'closed' in dark grey; with no PR nothing is shown.
